author: Oleh Andrus
text:
Shipped the first version of this blog on a bare http.server — no Flask, no Django, just BaseHTTPRequestHandler and a little routing.

Turns out you learn a lot more about HTTP when nothing is done for you.

author: Maria K.
text:
Today's bug: FileNotFoundError on 404.html.

Cause: Path() resolves to the working directory, not the script directory. Fix: Path(__file__).parent.
